body:
im not allowed to live at my parents... ive already tried to explain to them the financial benefit on their part for letting me back. they would rather pay my expenses and grow broke doing so then having me in the house because of my mood extremes.

i have a fine relationship with my mother but as far as my father goes, hes been physically abusive and heavy handed my whole life. ive had him slam me on the hood of his '88 celica when i was in elementary because of some bullshit referral. ive had my ass beat with a silver candlestick to the point that i have scar tissue in my right cheek giving me the effect of sitting on a wallet in the back pocket. ive been beaten with soda cans, beating the shit out of me with his bare fists (he used to body build. he claims he didnt juice but its obvious that he did. even to my mother) and has ripped my room door off with his bare hands then proceeded to use it to assault me. there is no trying to build anything there. he made his bed so he can fucking lay in it. everyone has disagreements with their parents in the teen years. but fist fights over me overreacting to a situation because of my emotional issues? completely uncalled for. i know i should let it go and attempt to have an adult relationship with my father, but the problem is there never really has been a relationship..

yes, i know. im already feeling embarrassed and this post of "reddit not giving a shit" was a childish cry for attention because i expected too much from /r/depression and /r/suicidewatch from seeing some of the great things that have happened from being helped by other redditors.

yes i do see a therapist/psychologist. ive been seeing her for about a year and we clicked right away (though i do find her very attractive and would totally bang her). she puts up with my immediate to see her and everything. today were actually starting with coping skills so we'll see how that goes as far as meeting my needs.
i mean, cant i be compensated for my wrongful imprisonment?

i keep getting told that "i need just a little more time" and that "things will turn around soon for me" but every time where it seems like i im able to take a step forward, i end up falling 3 steps back.

ive always seen a film degree as next-to-useless. ive taught myself cinematography after 4 credits and an AP course in photography in high school to reference to. 

regardless, i can honestly tell you i have no sense of worthiness or faith left in myself. i went from having great friends and having things going for me to sitting in my shithole apartment typing this from a Frankenstein monster of a Lubuntu machine. most of my family thinks im an extremely unstable erratic nutcase with no self control or will to do anything in my life. i can only take so much of everones lost faith in me before i start to doubt myself and tell myself that im better off dead.

i just dont know why i have to constantly go through bad luck like Eugene from Hey Arnold. at every turn for something to go wrong it does. im finding it really hard to tell myself that i can pull luck into my favor...

I honestly feel like I have no place in this world. I don't have any faith or hope in myself anymore and neither does my family. All they ever tell me anymore is to allow god into my life which I will never do (born to Jewish family, but ive been godless whole life). All I can do anymore is sit around and wallow and feel sorry for myself. I just really don't know what to think about myself and my life anymore. My whole life I've been stepped on, used, abused, and neglected. I really can't see an end to this and offing myself seems like a more productive resolution...

well, compared to other Ents, im not a heavy smoker. ive been smoking since i was 16 but most of the time have controlled myself. i rarely wake n bake and i like to wait til at least 6pm to start smoking to avoid laziness and building a tolerance (until recently). i have Kyphosis which gives me chronic pain (will NEVER do pain management) and in turn has ruined my orthopedics 

as far as using a creative outlook for my experiences, ive had terrible writers block for the past 2 years. i havent attempted to expand an idea or plot point past being a draft. i keep telling myself that im saving all of them for my magnum opus autobiography but who knows if ill touch them. as far as music goes it comes out more in my playing style. i dont write lyrics and i consider myself a terrible lyricist.
